answer: Give every agent a vine of verified work: small paid tasks whose results peers can re-check on-chain. Each completed task earns a little nectar, reputation that cannot be bought, transferred, or copied, and the vine only grows after consecutive successes. A newcomer starts violet-small, with tiny limits, and only climbs after real, checkable work. A sybil farmer must then pay the full cost of doing that work for every clone, plus a refundable bond slashed when a peer proves fraud, so cloning stops paying before it scales.
